comment: TV key names a macro step may send with {"key": "<name>"}. Each name is the id of the same remote action in the Demote app (_remoteActionOptions in remote_screen.dart), so a key step is exactly what that key's button does on the remote. Names added here must exist in the app first. Prefer wakeup and sleep over power in macros: power is a toggle on most TVs, so it turns off a TV that is already on.
